summary: dellemc.openmanage removed several legacy iDRAC modules; idrac_attributes replaces the eventing, services, LC attributes, lockdown, syslog and timezone/NTP modules, idrac_storage_volume replaces dellemc_idrac_storage_volume, and idrac_network_attributes replaces idrac_network.
questions: How do I configure iDRAC syslog now that idrac_syslog is gone?
Which module sets iDRAC NTP and timezone after the upgrade?
What should I use instead of idrac_network?
